items.claim: Norden-topchef Jan Rindbo sagde, at "we think the risk-reward is now more favourable in dry cargo", og begrundede et skift af kapital fra tank mod tørlast med en voksende ordrebog og geopolitisk usikkerhed i tankmarkedet.
items.source: Jan Rindbo, CEO, Dampskibsselskabet NORDEN, citeret i Splash247

items.claim: NORDEN oplyste i sin ugentlige rapportering, at aktietilbagekøbsprogrammet løber fra 14. august 2026 til og med senest 22. oktober 2026, og at det gennemføres inden for EU-forordningernes safe-harbour-ramme.

Dampskibsselskabet NORDEN A/S reported, in company announcement no. 231/2026, on the progress of its share buy-back programme and said the programme runs from 14 August 2026 up to and including no later than 22 October 2026.
items.source: Dampskibsselskabet NORDEN A/S company announcement no. 231/2026; contact given as Therese Mollevinge, Head of Investor Relations

items.claim: NORDEN disclosed in the same weekly report that major shareholder Motortramp A/S sold shares during the reporting period 25 September - 1 October 2026.
items.source: Dampskibsselskabet NORDEN A/S company announcement no. 231/2026
